title: DBA I
jobDescription:
About Mobi Kwik

Let's build a career to write a legacy together!

Mobi Kwik is India's leading Digital Financial Services platform and one of the country's largest Digital Wallets, trusted by over 167 million users and 4.4 million businesses. As a pioneer in the Fintech space, we offer a comprehensive suite of financial products, including Digital Payments, Credit, and Investments.

Following our successful IPO, we continue to drive innovation with a mission to democratize access to financial services for a billion Indians.

If you're passionate about building reliable, scalable, and high-performing database systems, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Manage and maintain My SQL and Mongo DB databases to ensure high availability, performance, and security.
  • Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, backups, and recovery.
  • Monitor database health, optimize queries, and improve overall system performance.
  • Implement database monitoring, automation, and maintenance processes.
  • Ensure database reliability, scalability, and disaster recovery readiness.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to support application deployments and resolve database-related issues.
  • Maintain data integrity, security, and compliance across database environments.
  • Support capacity planning, resource optimization, and production database operations.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong hands-on experience with My SQL and Mongo DB database administration.
  • Good understanding of Postgre SQL and Cassandra is an added advantage.
  • Experience in SQL query optimization and database performance tuning.
  • Knowledge of backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery strategies.
  • Familiarity with automation, scripting, and database monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure and production database environments.
  • Knowledge of database security, OS hardening, and best practices.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Ready to build the future of digital finance? Join Mobi Kwik and make an impact.

title: Manager - Business Development
jobDescription:
What you’ll do:

• Merchant Acquisition: Identify, approach, and acquire new merchants to onboard onto our EDC platform.

• EDC Onboarding: Work closely with merchants to understand their business requirements, configure our EDC solution to meet their needs, and ensure successful onboarding.

• Revenue Growth: Drive revenue growth by increasing the number of merchants on our EDC platform, increasing transaction volumes, and upselling/cross selling our services.

• Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with merchants, understanding their business needs and providing exceptional customer service.

• Market Research: Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and challenges in the payments industry, and provide insights to inform our business development strategy.



What you’ll possess:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing or a related field; MBA or relevant advanced degree is a plus.

• A minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, sales, or a related field, preferably in the payments industry.

title: SDET II
jobDescription:
SDET II (Software Development Engineer in Test)

We are seeking an experienced SDET II with strong expertise in Java, REST Assured, and API Automation Testing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing scalable automation frameworks, developing reliable automated test suites, validating microservices, and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable high-quality software releases.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Java.
  • Develop and execute API automation test scripts using REST Assured.
  • Validate REST APIs, request/response payloads, authentication mechanisms, and business workflows.
  • Create reusable automation libraries and utilities to improve framework efficiency.
  • Develop automated regression, integration, smoke, and end-to-end API test suites.
  • Collaborate with developers, product managers, and Dev Ops teams to ensure product quality throughout the SDLC.
  • Analyze application logs, troubleshoot failures, and perform root cause analysis.
  • Integrate automation suites with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or similar tools.
  • Maintain automation reports and improve overall automation coverage.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to automation framework enhancements.
  • Ensure quality standards and automation best practices across projects.

Technical Skills

  • Strong programming experience in Java.
  • Hands-on experience with REST Assured for API automation.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs and HTTP methods.
  • Experience with Test NG or JUnit.
  • Experience with Maven or Gradle.
  • Strong knowledge of JSON, XML, and API authentication mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, Bearer Token).
  • Experience using Postman and Swagger/Open API.
  • Good understanding of SQL for database validation.
  • Experience with Git for version control.
  • Hands-on experience with Jenkins or other CI/CD tools.
  • Experience working with Jira or similar defect/project management tools.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and automation best practices.
